_comment: Every status a gate can produce, in one document, against a committed JTL.
The point is coverage of the OUTPUT, not of the engine: PASS, WARN and FAIL alongside all
four NOT_JUDGED reasons, so the golden .json and .xml carry every branch of the counts, the
attainment block, the per-sampler assertStatus and the JUnit testcase shapes. A change that
moves any of them on an unedited file shows up as a diff in a pull request, which is the
property the deleted snapshot fixtures had and nothing replaced.
Thresholds are pinned to the fixed JTL and are not meant to be realistic.

assertions.description: NOT_JUDGED / NO_MATCH — a plan running a subset is legitimate
NOT_JUDGED / NO_VALUE — well-formed, unanswerable by this run
NOT_JUDGED / INVALID_RULE — fix the file, not the run
